summary: Verified version comparison + restore-version feature end-to-end. Backend restore endpoint works with all validation branches (403 for non-Sales, 400 when not needs_revision, 404 for unknown version). Restore creates a new version (v3) with old version's (v1) content and 'Restored from vX' change note; history records restored_version action. Frontend renders 3 versions correctly, shows 'Restore This Version' on non-current versions, Compare Versions button enters compare mode with checkbox selection limited to 2, side-by-side diff shows yellow-highlighted changed fields with red strike-through old values and green bold new values, and deal_value is INR formatted (₹1,00,000 / ₹2,00,000).
passed: Restore validation: CGO -> 403, non-revision status -> 400, unknown version -> 404
Restored v3 content matches v1 exactly (title, description, customer_name, industry, product, deal_value)
History contains restored_version action with version=3 and comment 'Restored from v1_2026-07-27 to v3_2026-07-27'
Version history UI shows v1, v2, v3 with CURRENT badge on v3
Restore This Version button visible on v1 and v2 only (2 buttons), not on current v3
Compare Versions button enters compare mode; checkbox selection limited to 2 (3rd click blocked, still 2 checked)
Diff view: 5 yellow-highlighted rows, 5 line-through old values (red), 5 green-bold new values
Deal values rendered as INR (₹1,00,000 and ₹2,00,000) in comparison view
'Restored from v1' change note visible on current version detail
action_items: Optional (out of scope of this feature): Sales user sees Approve/Return/Reject action panel on their own proposal in needs_revision — verify RBAC on Take Action panel visibility (pre-existing, not blocking).
